denext/rules-of-hooks: `useEffect` is called conditionally
  at lint-rules-of-hooks.tsx:8:5

    7 |   if (live) {
  > 8 |     useEffect(() => {
            ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
    9 |       const t = setInterval(() => setNow(Date.now()), 1000);

  denext matches each hook to its state by call order: the third hook call on every render reads the third slot. A hook inside an `if`, a loop or a callback runs on some renders and not others, which shifts every later hook onto the wrong state.

  Fix: Call `useEffect` unconditionally at the top level and put the condition inside it, e.g.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!condition) return;
    // …
  }, [condition]);

  Original (deno lint):
  │ error[denext/rules-of-hooks]: `useEffect` is called conditionally. Hooks must run in the same order on every render — call it at the top level. [denext/rules-of-hooks]
  │     --> /app/lint-rules-of-hooks.tsx:8:5
  │      | 
  │ >  8 |     useEffect(() => {
  │      |     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  │ >  9 |       const t = setInterval(() => setNow(Date.now()), 1000);
  │ > 10 |       return () => clearInterval(t);
  │ > 11 |     }, []);
  │      |     ^^^^^^
